highlights: Turn any workflow into reusable AI agent software that installs on 14+ tools — no spec writing, no prompt engineering, no coding required.
Every AI coding tool — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex, Gemini, Kiro, and more — starts from zero.
So every person re-explains the same workflows in every conversation.
Agent skills fix this. A skill is structured knowledge your agent loads automatically — like installing an app.

The catch: building a proper skill requires understanding the spec format, writing clear prompt instructions, designing how information loads progressively, writing functional code, and getting activation keywords right.
Even simple skills take multiple rounds of iteration to get right.
Option A — One-liner (installs to all detected tools):
This clones to ~/.agents/skills/agent-skill-creator and symlinks to every detected global platform (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Goose, OpenCode, Copilot).
